patch.description: Update session status. Rejected with 409 for COMPLETED/CANCELLED sessions and for IN_PROGRESS -> COMPLETED when the session has no products.

delete.description: Hard delete. COMPLETED/CANCELLED sessions are always deletable; IN_PROGRESS only when it has no products and no stock opname results. All child rows (products, barcodes, results, racks, coordinators) are removed by cascade.

post.description: Upsert products + barcodes from a PRODUK.DBF ("produk") and BARCODE.DBF ("barcode") multipart pair. Idempotent. Use ?dry_run=true to validate without writing.
Removes all products and barcodes of one session. Requires ?sessionId=&confirm=true. Stock opname history is untouched.

delete.description: Rejected with 409 when the session is final, the rack was already uploaded, the rack has items, or it is the last rack of the coordinator.

post.summary: Join a coordinator by scanning its QR code
post.description: Validates the coordinator and returns its racks with upload history and live contents. Mobile clients should use item_count and is_empty to display the current rack contents; these values come from live stock_opname data, not from the upload snapshot. uploaded_at only marks upload history and does not indicate whether the rack still has items. There is no push notification: call this endpoint again to refresh. Join is only allowed while the coordinator status is IN_PROGRESS.

get.summary: Get upload history for a coordinator

post.summary: Submit a batch of racks as one upload
post.description: Creates one upload row grouping every rack in the batch. A rack can only belong to one upload; when any rack was already uploaded the whole batch is rejected with 409.

get.summary: Download the upload PDF for a rack
get.description: Rendered from the immutable snapshots of every rack in the upload, grouped per rack.

post.summary: Move stock opname results to another rack
post.description: Moves all results of a source rack, or only the given result_ids, into a target rack in the same session. If the target rack already has the same PLU, quantities are merged.

get.summary: List stock opname audit entries
get.description: Returns administrative changes to stock opname results, newest first.

get.summary: List audit batch summaries
get.description: Returns one summary row per bulk audit action. Use GET /stockopname/audits?batchId=<uuid> for details.

barcodes.description: Replaces the whole barcode set when present.

barcode.description: Scanned barcode. Either barcode or plu is required.

plu.description: Product PLU. Either barcode or plu is required.

uploaded_at.description: Upload-history marker. May be set even when the rack is now empty.

item_count.description: Live number of result rows currently in the rack.

is_empty.description: True when the rack has no live result rows.

rak.description: Racks owned by the coordinator. item_count and is_empty are live values for mobile; uploaded_at is the upload-history marker.

upload_number.description: Urutan upload per koordinator. 1 = upload pertama.

result_ids.description: Omit to move the whole source rack.
